Marie, such as we have the lowest number of hospital beds per capita per senior, we have the second lowest number of long-term care beds per capita per senior, and the demand for housing and care options is high now and only going to get higher every passing year. Next slide. In addition, we're looking at technological resources to be able to reduce isolation for area seniors, knowing what we know now of infectious disease and how important it has become to keep people away from one another, isolated, socially distant. We've noticed that over the last nine months that has had a profound impact on the overall mental health of many of the seniors due to isolation. Marie through our diversified services, whether traditionally or digitally, continue to promote and support the arts and culture in the courtyard corridor through our programs, workshops, and events, and continue to contribute to the vibrant and attractive downtown air of the city.
